name: Claude
freeTierNote: Limited usage every 5 hours and weekly.
bestFor: Long documents, careful edits, and coding work that needs a large context window
skipIf: You want the cheapest Google-integrated assistant or a consumer image studio
keyFeatures: Large context window for long briefs
Nuanced prose editing without flattening voice
Pairs with Claude Code for terminal repos
limitations: Not a dedicated live-web citation engine
Fewer native Google Drive integrations than Gemini
summary: The professional writing and coding assistant. Slower to collect consumer toys, stronger on long context and Claude Code.
body: Claude is the assistant we send people to when ChatGPT’s tone feels like a brochure. It holds large briefs, edits without flattening voice, and pairs with Claude Code for repository work. Anthropic ships fewer consumer gadgets. That is a feature if your job is prose, policy, or a messy codebase. Pro is priced like the rest of the $20 club. Heavy agent use pushes people into Max, which is a different budget conversation. Last verified against Anthropic’s public plans on 19 Sep 2026.
notes: Pair with Cursor if you want an IDE plus a terminal agent
Projects and artifacts matter more than chat skins
Not the first pick for Google Drive natives
